'''Armorjaw''' is a [[Water]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Ospisces]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Dagondeep]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "There's no turning back now. Armorjaw has outgrown the basin, quietly charting a course toward Devil's Reef. When an attempt to reach out is given, only a cold, distant stare is returned, as if quietly questioning your allegiance to humanity."

Armorjaw is a red rarity Tatari that acts as a frontline AoE bruiser, inflicting a debuff to reduce incoming damage.

== Appearance ==
feeeeeeesh

Armorjaw's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form recolors its blue fins to a teal color.

== Evolution Trial ==
Armorjaw's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Dagondeep]], you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play Fishing Contest (use x6000 fishing rods) or Zobo Shooter (use x1,200,000 bullet coints).
* Obtain 60 cards from card packs.

== Strategy ==
[[File:Armorjaw Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Armorjaw's Attack Range]]
Tidesurge: Weak reduces the damage that Zobos deal, helping Armorjaw stay alive while dealing damage.
